steps.condition: Select only when the atomic requested outcome matches: Diagnose missing, duplicate, malformed, or misidentified APM signals from read-only platform evidence and route fixes to authorized enablement or installation owners.
hard_gates: Troubleshooting is read-only: it cannot install agents, change sampling or tags, restart services, remap identity, or claim a fix from diagnosis alone.
Preflight never changes remote state; observation never executes recovery; coordination never performs specialist actions; one remote authorization never cascades.
inputs: Failed verification evidence, platform variant, service configuration, logs, and authority boundary.

steps.condition: Select only when the atomic requested outcome matches: Investigate one error-monitoring issue from read-only event evidence to an evidence-bounded root-cause hypothesis and repair recommendation without provider or source mutation.
hard_gates: Issue investigation is read-only: it cannot resolve, mute, assign, comment, change grouping, edit source, or treat one stack trace as proven root cause.
Preflight never changes remote state; observation never executes recovery; coordination never performs specialist actions; one remote authorization never cascades.
inputs: Issue identity, event context, release, environment, source access, and authority boundary.

steps.condition: Select only when the atomic requested outcome matches: Coordinate an active incident's severity, roles, timeline, hypotheses, mitigation options, communications, recovery criteria, and closure recommendation from read-only evidence without executing provider actions.
hard_gates: Coordination under external-read authority cannot acknowledge, silence, assign, comment, change traffic, scale, restart, deploy, rollback, remediate, or close provider incidents; every action routes to a separately authorized owner.
Preflight never changes remote state; observation never executes recovery; coordination never performs specialist actions; one remote authorization never cascades.
inputs: An active production anomaly, impact evidence, alerts, and available mitigation controls.
outputs: roles, timeline, fact, hypothesis, and decision log
update drafts for each audience with next-update time

steps.condition: Select only when the atomic requested outcome matches: Diagnose governed production LLM traces to evidence-bounded root-cause hypotheses across prompts, retrieval, models, tools, data, latency, and user context without remediation.
hard_gates: Production LLM root cause requires governed trace provenance, versioned components, successful comparison cases, competing hypotheses, and a first divergent invariant; one bad output or model label is insufficient.
Preflight never changes remote state; observation never executes recovery; coordination never performs specialist actions; one remote authorization never cascades.
inputs: Authorized trace data, incident scope, time window, privacy boundary, and service context.

steps.condition: Select only when the atomic requested outcome matches: Execute one exact approved release rollback when current post-deploy evidence meets a predeclared rollback condition, with bounded blast radius and recovery verification.
hard_gates: Rollback requires a named exact recovery target, met predeclared condition, current evidence, migration compatibility, bounded blast radius, health verification, and fresh per-action authorization; observation alone cannot execute it.
Preflight never changes remote state; observation never executes recovery; coordination never performs specialist actions; one remote authorization never cascades.
inputs: A deployed change, health evidence, provider state, and rollback authorization.
